Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 6
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner arbitrarily redefined “nationality” by present-day birthplace and concluded “French,” ignoring the historically appropriate identification of Frederick I Barbarossa as German (a German king/Holy Roman Emperor). They relied on place-article citations (Haguenau) rather than authoritative biographical sources and contradicted their own earlier acknowledgement that he was a German ruler, leading to the incorrect final answer.
